sources.title: Continuing Care Retirement Community, CCRC | Newton, Boston
sources.excerpt: Each year, each resident also commits to a personalized plan of learning and fitness activities.

facts.text: Independent-living one-bedroom plans range 640–1,080 sq ft; two-bedroom plans 875–1,933 sq ft, with den options, full kitchens and washers/dryers. Some homes have balconies/patios; layouts do not establish vacancies.

The standard entrance-fee contract advertises a 90% refund on exit/death. A separate declining-balance contract has a smaller initial payment and a declining refund, reaching no refund after 100 months per the FAQ. No numeric entrance or monthly rate is published on these inspected pages.

Independent-living monthly fees include an apartment, meal plan, housekeeping, utilities, amenities/activities and up to 60 annual hours from the on-site wellness center; additional hours can be purchased.

Lasell Studios supportive living advertises three daily meals, daily-living help and 24-hour supervision for residents including those with memory impairment; its monthly fee is higher than independent living and requires a separate quote.

Lasell House is the separate on-campus skilled nursing/rehabilitation setting. The provider describes eligible community residents receiving higher care at the independent-living rate plus meal fees, subject to the actual agreement and coverage.
Joining the Lasell Village apartment waitlist requires a nonrefundable $2,500 application fee. Applicants may decline an offered apartment without losing their place.
Independent-living applicants undergo financial review and cognitive/physical assessment; the provider says applicants must be able to live independently.
The university-based community shares a campus with Lasell University; residents may take college classes and commit annually to a personalized learning/fitness plan.
Independent living advertises a staffed dining room, café and takeout meals.
Advertised campus amenities include a fitness center, heated indoor pool, art studio and raised-bed gardening area.

availability.text: Lasell Village expressly publishes an apartment waitlist. Timing depends on apartment type and location; no current wait duration or available-unit count is published.

notes: Waitlist page is undated and does not establish immediate inventory.
Lasell Studios supportive living and Lasell House skilled nursing are distinct from independent-living apartment rates and admission scope.
The provider's historical CMS-star claim on its marketing page was not copied into this offerings record.
